faq_one: 1- What is Roaya Pay Payment Solutions and Software Company ?
faq_two: It is a company specialized in providing advanced electronic payment solutions and software services that support the digital transformation of institutions and individuals with the highest standards of quality and security .
faq_three: 2- What services does your company provide in the field of financial and technical solutions ?
faq_four: We provide electronic payment gateways, digital wallets, electronic points of sale (POS), financial collection solutions, and customized software for various sectors such as commerce, education, and government .
faq_five: 3- How can I benefit from Roaya Pay services for payment solutions and software ?
faq_six: By contacting the customer service team or through the official website, analyzing your technical needs, and choosing the appropriate solution for you .
faq_seven: 4- What is the payment method through Roaya Pay portals ?
faq_eight: After integrating a payment gateway with your website or app, customers can choose a product or service, then pay electronically using credit cards, digital wallets, or bank transfers, all with complete security .
faq_nine: 5- Does Roaya Pay provide electronic points of sale (POS) for stores ?
faq_ten: Yes, we provide modern POS devices to easily accept payments via bank cards or electronic wallets .
faq_eleven: 6- What payment methods does Roaya Pay support ?
faq_twelve: We support all popular payment methods: Visa, MasterCard, Meeza, e-wallets such as Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash, in addition to electronic installment services .
faq_thirteen: 7- Are Roaya Pay services available to individuals or only to companies ?
faq_fourteen: Our services are available to individuals, companies, online stores, and governmental and private institutions .
faq_fifteen: 8- Is it possible to pay by mobile phone via Roaya Pay services ?
faq_sixteen: Of course! Roaya Pay offers smart mobile payment solutions through its easy-to-use and secure app .
faq_seventeen: 9- How secure are transactions with Roaya Pay for payment solutions and software ?
faq_eighteen: We adhere to the highest global security standards (PCI DSS), encrypting and protecting data against any breach to ensure a reliable payment experience .
faq_nineteen: 10- Does Roaya Pay provide ongoing technical support to customers ?
faq_twenty: Yes, the company's management is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to ensure continuity of operations and support customers with all their inquiries and technical issues .
